title: Penetration Tester (VAPT)
summary: A penetration tester is paid to attack a company's web apps, networks and APIs the way a real attacker would, and report what they find. VAPT stands for vulnerability assessment and penetration testing; the role sits in a security team or consultancy, often running CERT-In empanelled audits.
dailyDuties: Run web, network and API penetration tests end to end
Scan and enumerate networks with Nmap from Kali Linux
Exploit OWASP Top 10 issues in web apps
Write small exploit and automation scripts in Python or Bash

skills.expectation: Run web, network and API penetration tests end to end
Rate findings by CVSS and retest fixes
Scan and enumerate networks with Nmap
Write small exploit or automation scripts
Write small exploit or automation scripts
Write a clear VAPT report for CERT-In empanelled audits
